analytics.name: Analytic 2066
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a field device loading a modified autorun image (boot read-only memory, bootloader firmware) detected by a discrepancy between the device's declared firmware hash and the authorized firmware inventory hash, with post-reboot device behavior diverging from expected (unexpected protocols active, unanticipated network connections). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

tuning.description: Inventory of binaries legitimately authorized to be referenced by autorun/startup mechanisms on ICS hosts.
Time window correlating removable media insertion with a subsequent autorun configuration change.

log_sources.name: assetinventory:FirmwareHash
log_sources.channel: device firmware hash does not match authorized firmware inventory following a reboot event

log_sources.name: NSM:Connections
log_sources.channel: device establishes new network connections or activates protocols not seen in pre-reboot baseline
